description: This file defines the AssignGroups class, which manages group assignment popups, mass assignment, and related security group functionalities within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: AssignGroups
classes.description: A class handling security group assignment, popup behaviors, and mass assignment management in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: popup_select
methods.description: Handles the selection of security groups for a bean, adding groups if selected, or handling duplicate checks.

methods.name: popup_onload
methods.description: Manages the client-side popup loading, including rendering if necessary and populating selected groups.

methods.name: mass_assign
methods.description: Handles mass assignment of security groups to records, including rendering the mass assign form and validation.
